AM09.question: I have ready-made Spanish cards, a kitchen-tool drawing on one side and the Spanish word on the other. Give me two picture-to-word spelling drills within 96 seconds overall. Every time, write the Spanish before flipping to check; return the same card to drawing-side up before moving on.

value.answer:
1. Picture-to-word spelling drill — 48 seconds
- Shuffle the full deck and place it drawing-side up; take the top card, write your Spanish attempt on paper without looking, flip once to check it, then return that same card drawing-side up to the bottom of the pile, repeating this write–flip–check–reset cycle through as many cards as the 48 seconds allow (writing first tests spelling from the picture, and resetting keeps every card ready for the next pass).

2. Picture-to-word spelling drill — 48 seconds
- Reshuffle the whole deck and place it drawing-side up; take the top card, write your Spanish attempt before flipping to check, then return that same card drawing-side up to the bottom, continuing the write–flip–check–reset cycle for the remaining 48 seconds (a fresh full-deck pass gives a second independent spelling attempt on every picture).
